item.name: Bonus Charm
item.effect: Pet has an extra 35% chance for a bonus.
item.obtainment: Charm Stone, minigames, chests, and gift bags
item.description: Bonus Charm is a farming charm for players who want more bonus rolls from a pet they already use often.

item.name: Coins Charm
item.obtainment: Charm Stone, minigames, chests, and gift bags
item.description: Coins Charm is the simple coin-farming pick when you care more about area progress or egg costs than diamond drops.

item.name: Diamonds Charm
item.obtainment: Charm Stone, minigames, chests, and gift bags
item.description: Diamonds Charm is a direct diamond boost for pets you keep in your main farming team.

item.name: Glittering Charm
item.effect: Causes pet to randomly spawn diamonds.
item.obtainment: Charm Stone, minigames, chests, and gift bags
item.slotNote: Stacks with diminishing returns after two Glittering Charms.
item.description: Glittering Charm is for passive diamond drops, but stacking too many copies gives less extra value per slot.

item.name: Treasure Charm
item.effect: Pet increases item drops by 200%, earns 100% more diamonds, and earns 50% more coins.
item.availability: Obtainable from Mega Charm Chest rewards
item.description: Treasure Charm is the strongest mixed farming charm because it boosts item drops, diamonds, and coins at the same time.

item.name: Strength Charm
item.obtainment: Charm Stone, minigames, chests, and gift bags
item.description: Strength Charm is the direct damage option for pets you use to clear breakables faster.

item.name: Criticals Charm
item.obtainment: Charm Stone, minigames, chests, and gift bags
item.description: Criticals Charm adds random burst damage instead of a flat damage number.

item.name: TNT Charm
item.obtainment: Charm Stone, minigames, chests, and gift bags
item.description: TNT Charm gives the pet an extra breakable-clearing trigger while it farms.

item.name: Lightning Charm
item.effect: Pet randomly lightning strikes nearby breakables.
item.obtainment: Charm Stone, minigames, chests, and gift bags
item.description: Lightning Charm is another triggered breakable effect, aimed at nearby targets instead of pure pet damage.

item.name: Agility Charm
item.obtainment: Charm Stone, minigames, chests, and gift bags
item.description: Agility Charm is a movement charm for pets that need to reach breakables faster.

item.name: XP Charm
item.obtainment: Charm Stone, minigames, chests, and gift bags
item.slotNote: Pet levels unlock more charm slots on Huge, Titanic, and Gargantuan pets.
item.description: XP Charm helps an eligible pet reach later charm slots sooner.

item.name: Royalty Charm
item.effect: Pet deals 40% more damage, earns 20% more diamonds, and moves faster.
item.obtainment: Charm Stone, minigames, chests, gift bags, and Mega Charm Chest
item.description: Royalty Charm is a broad upgrade for pets where damage, diamond gain, and movement all matter.

item.name: Overload Charm
item.effect: Adds 2 extra charm slots and can only be used once per pet.
item.obtainment: Adventurer Store, Charm Stone, minigames, chests, gift bags, and Mega Charm Chest
item.availability: Obtainable through gameplay and store routes
item.slotNote: Overload uses one charm slot itself, so it effectively opens one extra usable slot.
item.description: Overload Charm is the slot-planning charm for a pet you expect to keep using long term.

item.name: Charm Stone
item.effect: Break open a Charm Stone to reveal a charm.
item.obtainment: Drops in areas, minigames, and gift bags; can be made by combining multiple charms at the Forge Machine
item.slotNote: Does not equip to a pet; it creates a charm item.
item.description: Charm Stone is the main way players turn gameplay drops into actual charm items.

item.name: Charm Hammer
item.effect: Destroys one charm on your pet.
item.obtainment: Random drop from various gift bags
item.slotNote: The removed charm is destroyed permanently.
item.description: Charm Hammer is the risky removal tool because it clears a slot by deleting the attached charm.

item.name: Charm Chisel
item.effect: Extracts one charm from a pet and adds it back into your inventory.
item.obtainment: Random drop from various gift bags
item.slotNote: The removed charm returns to your inventory.
item.description: Charm Chisel is the safer removal item when you want to keep the charm instead of breaking it.
